mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conscious and carefully planned schedule of loans acquired either for development purposes or to support the balance of payment."
External debt management is a conscious and carefully planned schedule of loans acquired either for development purposes or to support the balance of payment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a specialised, functional area found under the general classification, public administration and finance."
Public financial management is a specialised, functional area found under the general classification, public administration and finance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a 12-month accounting period without regard to a calendar year."
The fiscal year is a 12-month accounting period without regard to a calendar year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important decision making process in public institutions."
Budgeting is the most important decision making process in public institutions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a crucial factor in ensuring proper control of public funds or any fund for that matter."
Auditing is a crucial factor in ensuring proper control of public funds or any fund for that matter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the case in socialist/communist economies the public sector takes the central seat as the dominant sector."
The reverse is the case in socialist/communist economies the public sector takes the central seat as the dominant sector.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the formal law-making body of a country."
The legislature is the formal law-making body of a country.

Re-financing of trade arrears is a new loan that is procured by a debtor to pay-off an existing debt if it involved short-term trade debt.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with discretionary control of money supply by the monetary authorities (Central Bank with Central Government) in other to achieve stated or desired economic goals."
Monetary policy is concerned with discretionary control of money supply by the monetary authorities (Central Bank with Central Government) in other to achieve stated or desired economic goals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the expression of taxation, public revenue or public debt."
Fiscal is the expression of taxation, public revenue or public debt.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the manipulation of forms when rendering returns and claims as regard the taxpayer's income status and the accompanying responsibilities."
Tax evasion is the manipulation of forms when rendering returns and claims as regard the taxpayer's income status and the accompanying responsibilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the multi-lateral institutions; an affiliate of the World Bank, involved in the act of providing loans for needy nations."
The IMF is one of the multi-lateral institutions; an affiliate of the World Bank, involved in the act of providing loans for needy nations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of controlling costs which include the preparation of budgets."
Budgetary control is a system of controlling costs which include the preparation of budgets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an activity that lies on the critical path."
Critical activity is an activity that lies on the critical path.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the tool of decision and literally the biggest process."
Budget is the tool of decision and literally the biggest process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a compulsory payment or levy imposed via legislation by the government of a country on the income of the residents."
Taxation is defined as a compulsory payment or levy imposed via legislation by the government of a country on the income of the residents.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the backbone of any financial control system."
Budget and budgetary control is the backbone of any financial control system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a cost-benefit-approach to budgeting which ensures value for money activities which involves the use of decision packages."
Zero-based budgeting is a cost-benefit-approach to budgeting which ensures value for money activities which involves the use of decision packages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the welfare of its citizenry."
The government is concerned with the welfare of its citizenry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a convenient method of showing the logical sequence of activities in a project."
A network is a convenient method of showing the logical sequence of activities in a project.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the least amount of reserve a bank must maintain with Central Bank of Nigeria expressed as a ratio of each individual banks total liability."
Cash Reserve Requirement is the least amount of reserve a bank must maintain with Central Bank of Nigeria expressed as a ratio of each individual banks total liability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sequence of activities that leads from the starting node to the finishing node."
A path is a sequence of activities that leads from the starting node to the finishing node.
